content.text: Oe, ka taminaw ka kâlawk hah tarawi awh nateh,
ka dei e lawk hah na hnâpakeng awh.
Bangnuenae lahoi ka pahni ka ang vaiteh,
ayan e lawkkaru hah ka pâpho han.
Hothateh, ka thai teh, ka panue tangcoung e
mintoenaw ni a dei awh e doeh.
A canaw koehoi kâhrawk mahoeh.
Ka tho hane senaw koevah,
BAWIPA pholennae, a thaonae,
hoi hno kângairu a sak e hah ka dei han.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, mintoenaw hah kâ a poe teh,
a ca catounnaw koe a panue sak awh nahanlah,
Jakop koe lawkpanuesaknae hah acak sak teh,
Isarel koe kâlawk hah a poe.
Kaawm han rae se hoi ka tâcawt han rae camonaw ni,
a catounnaw koe a dei awh vaiteh,
a panue awh nahanlah,
Cathut dawk a ngaihawi awh nahan hoi
Cathut hnosak hah pahnim laipalah
kâpoelawknaw a pahnim awh hoeh nahanlah,
Mintoenaw patetlah lungpatanae,
taranthawnae, kalan e hno dawk a lung kaawm hoeh e,
Cathut hanelah yuemkamcu hoeh e muitha lah ao awh hoeh nahane doeh.
Ephraim catoun teh tarantuknae a khohna teh licung a patuep ei,
tarantuk hnin navah a yawng.
Cathut lawkkam tarawi awh hoeh.
Kâlawk tarawi e ngai awh hoeh.
A sak e hoi hno kângairu a sak e hah,
a pahnim awh.
A na mintoenaw e mithmu vah,
kângairu hno hah Izip ram
Zoan tanghling dawk a sak.
Talîpui hah a kapek teh ahnimanaw hah a cei sak.
Tui hah hnopai patetlah a pâhlawp.
Kanîthun hai tâmai hoi a hrawi teh,
tangmin karoitawi hmaiang hoi a hrawi.
Kahrawngum vah, lungsong a bawng teh,
talîpui tui patetlah moikapap e tui a pânei.
Lungsong thung hoi tui a tâco sak teh,
palangpui patetlah a lawng sak.
Hatei, ama taranlahoi hoehoe a yon awh teh,
kahrawngum vah Lathueng Poung taranlahoi taran a thaw awh.
Ca han a ngai poung awh e hah a hei awh teh,
a lungthin hoi Cathut hah a tanouk awh.
Bokheiyah, Cathut taranlahoi a dei awh e teh,
kahrawngum vah Cathut ni
rawca na poe thai awh han na maw, telah ati awh.
Khenhaw! tui a tâco teh,
tuiko muen ka kawi lah a lawng nahan lah
lungsongpui hah a hem.
Rawca hai a poe thai namaw.
A taminaw hah moi a poe thai han na ou, telah ati awh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni hote lawk hah a thai teh a lungkhuek.
Hat toteh, Jakop taranlahoi hmaito a tâco teh,
Isarel taranlahoi a lungkhuek.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut hah yuem awh hoeh.
A rungngangnae hai kâuep awh hoeh.
Hottelah nahlangva, lathueng lae tâmai hah kâ a poe teh,
kalvan longkha hah a paawng pouh.
Ca hane mana hah ahnimouh lathueng a rak sak teh,
kalvanlae rawca hah a poe.
Taminaw ni thaonae
rawca hah a ca awh teh,
kaboumlah ca hane a patawn.
Kanîtholae kahlî hah kalvan a tho sak teh,
a hnotithainae lahoi a cum lae kahlî hah a tho sak.
Vaiphu patetlah moi hah a rak sak teh,
rathei ka tawn e tavanaw hah tuirai e
sadi yit touh apap awh.
A roenae tengpam
petkâkalup lah a bo pouh.
Hateh, a ca awh teh king a boum awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a ngai awh e patetlah a poe.
Hatei, a ngai awh e rawca a hmawt awh hoehnahlan,
a ca awh lahun navah,
Cathut lungkhueknae teh ahnimouh koe a pha.
A tami tha kaawmnaw hah a thei teh,
Isarel thoundounnaw hah koung a rawp sak.
Hottelah nahlangva, hoehoe a yon awh teh,
hno kalen a sak awh e hai bout yuem awh hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, hringyung hnin hah ayawmyin lah a coung sak awh teh,
lungpuennae hoi a kum teh a baw sak awh.
Ahnimanaw hah a thei awh teh,
a ma tawng hanelah a ban awh teh,
atangcalah Cathut heh a tawng awh.
Cathut teh amamae lungsongpui doeh tie a panue awh teh,
Lathueng Poung Cathut teh na
karatangkung doeh tie a panue awh.
Hateiteh, ama teh a pahni hoi a pholen teh,
lai hoi laithoe a dei awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimae lungthin teh a hmalah lan hoeh,
a lawkkam dawk yuemkamcu awh hoeh.
Hatei, ama teh lungmanae hoi akawi teh,
a payonnae heh a ngaithoum teh,
koung raphoe hoeh.
Bokheiyah, avai moikapap lungkhueknae a roum sak teh,
a lungphuennae kaman sak ngai hoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, takthai lah ao awh teh,
bout ban hoeh hanelah, kâha a poe e tie hah pahnim awh hoeh.
Thingyeiyawn vah vai nâyittouh maw
a lungkhuek sak awh teh, ramke vah avai nâyittouh maw
a lungmathoe sak awh toe.
Bokheiyah, atuhoitu Cathut a tanouk awh teh,
Isarelnaw e Tami Kathoung hah a taran awh.
A thaonae pâkuem ngai awh hoeh,
a tarannaw koehoi a rungngang ei nakunghai,
pâkuem ngai awh hoeh.
Izip ram hoi Zoan yawn dawk
kângairu hno a sak e hoi.
Ahnimae palang hah thipaling lah a coung sak teh,
ahnimae tuikhunaw hai nei thai hoeh hanlah
thipaling lah koung a coung sak.
Ahnimouh ka kei e bitseinaw hoi,
ahnimouh karaphoekung ekkanaw hah a tha pouh.
Ahnimae a pawhiknaw hah,
ahri ni ca hanelah a poe teh,
a tawksak awh e a pawhik hah samtongnaw a poe pouh.
Ahnimae misurnaw teh roun ni koung a raphoe pouh teh,
thailahei kungnaw hai tadamtui ni koung a thei pouh.
Ahnimae saringnaw hai roun ni dêi hanelah a poe pouh teh,
saringnaw hah kei ni a ka pouh.
Takitho e a lungkhueknae hah
ahnimouh lathueng a rabawk teh,
lungkhueknae, lungpoutnae, hoi runae hah
ahnimouh koe thoenae kaphawtkung
kalvan tami totouh a tha pouh.
A lungkhueknae hanlah lamthung a sak,
a hringnae hah duenae hlak pasai laipalah,
lacik mathout hah letlang a poe.
Izip vah camin pueng hoi Ham e rim
a thaonae hmaloe poung e hoi koung a raphoe.
Hatei, a taminaw teh tu patetlah a hrawi teh,
saringnaw patetlah kahrawngum vah a hrawi.
Karoumcalah a hrawi teh, taki hane banghai awm hoeh.
A tarannaw teh talîpui ni koung a ramuk.
Hahoi, ramri kathoung, aranglae kut hoi a tawn e,
mon totouh a hrawi.
Ahnimae hmalah, alouke miphunnaw hah a pâlei pouh.
A pang awh hane râw hah a bangnue pouh teh,
alouklouk lah hmuen a poe.
Hat nahlangva, Lathueng Poung Cathut hah
a tanouk awh teh, a lungkhuek sak awh teh,
a panuesaknae lawk hah tarawi awh hoeh.
A na mintoenaw patetlah a kamlang awh teh,
yuemkamcu hoeh lah a kâroe awh.
Dumyennae licung patetlah a kâkamei awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimae hmuerasangnaw ni
a lungkhuek sak teh,
a sak awh e meikaphawknaw ni dipma sinnae a tâco sak.
Hetheh Cathut ni a thai toteh,
puenghoi a lungkhuek teh,
Isarel hah puenghoi a panuet.
Hatdawkvah, taminaw koe a ta e
Shiloh rim koe totouh a ceitakhai.
A thaonae teh san lah a coung sak teh,
a lentoenae teh a tarannaw kut dawk a poe.
A taminaw tahloi a kâhmo sak teh,
râw lah a coe e naw koe a lungkhuek.
A thoundounnaw teh hmai ni a kak awh teh,
a tanglanaw ni vâ kâhmo awh hoeh.
A vaihmanaw teh tahloi hoi a thei awh eiteh,
lahmainaw ni khui awh hoeh.
BAWIPA teh ka ip e patetlah a kâhlaw teh,
misurtui kecu dawk ka hram e athakaawme tami patetlah a hram.
A taran hah a pâlei teh,
a yungyoe min mathoenae hah a poe.
Hothloilah Joseph rim hah a pahnawt teh,
Ephraim miphun hah rawi ngai hoeh.
Ama koehoi Judah miphun,
Zion mon ka pahren e heh a rawi.
A hmuen kathoung hah karasang e patetlah a sak teh,
talai patetlah a yungyoe acak sak.
A san Devit hai a rawi teh
tutakha thung hoi a la.
Tumanu, a canaw ouk a hrawi e patetlah,
a tami Jakop hoi a coe e râw Isarelnaw
khenyawnkung hanelah a la.
Hothloilah, a lungthin ahawi e patetlah,
a khetyawt teh, a thoumnae kut hoi a hrawi awh.
